thread:
amanda: Quick sync on error contract — we keep seeing SDKs diverge on whether to surface `message` vs a user-facing string. Need a small, standard shape that all SDKs map to typed exceptions.
jason: Can we land on a compact default payload for production and an opt-in verbose mode for dev? Mobile teams complained about payload size.
amanda: yes. header idea: `X-Error-Detail: compact|verbose`. Compact should include: code, status. Optional: retryable, retry_after. Verbose includes full message, meta, docs_url, user_message.
priya: For parity, we should standardize key names: `code` (namespaced), `status` (int), `message` (internal), `user_message` (short), `retryable` (bool), `retry_after` (sec|null), `retry_hint` (string|null), `meta` (stringified map ok for compact?).
lucas: Suggest adding `user_action` string too (e.g., "refresh_token", "contact_support") which SDKs can map to buttons in sample apps. Avoid binary inference.
emily: Sample apps should show `user_message` and a small "details" expander that reveals `message` only when X-Error-Detail=verbose. Keeps onboarding calm.
jason: HTTP-to-retry mapping proposal: 429 => retryable=true unless explicitly false; 5xx => retryable=true; 4xx => retryable=false except when `retry_hint` or `retryable=true` present. SDKs should not guess beyond that.
priya: We'll add a canonical example in the API docs. Example verbose payload: ```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "rate_limit.exceeded",
    "status": 429,
    "message": "Too many requests from IP 1.2.3.4 in 60s",
    "user_message": "You're being rate limited. Try again in a few seconds.",
    "user_action": "wait_retry",
    "retryable": true,
    "retry_after": 12,
    "retry_hint": "backoff",
    "meta": "docs:/errors#rate_limit.exceeded"
  }
}```
amanda: Good. For compact mode, this would shrink to: ```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "rate_limit.exceeded",
    "status": 429,
    "retry_after": 12
  }
}```
jason: SDK behavior: parse into typed exceptions, expose fields on the exception object (code,status,user_message,retry_after,retryable,user_action,docs_url), and provide a convenience `.shouldRetry()` implementing the HTTP-to-retry mapping but overridable by `retryable` field. Add tests to ensure parity.
lucas: Note: Go SDK currently failed a CI test because it treated 401 as retryable in one branch. Need explicit mapping unit tests.

emily: I'll update sample app UI after API change lands so it respects compact vs verbose headers and uses `user_action` for CTA labels.
priya: Action items: 1) I'll open API PR to add `user_message`, `user_action`, `retryable`, and `X-Error-Detail` header support. 2) DevEx: add sample-app wiring + UX pattern. 3) SDK leads: implement typed exceptions and add parity tests referencing canonical examples.
amanda: Timeline: aim to land API change + docs this week, SDK tests in next sprint. Keep this thread updated.
priya: Drafting PR now, will tag @jason for review.
jason: Will review, I'll also add a test matrix for status->retry logic.
